what_happened.line: The Select Board held a goals workshop listing reuse options for the old primary school, with rough costs, and took no vote on any option.
Members disagreed over conveyance of the old primary school and over senior housing as a use.

The board discussed town liability for trees the Planning Board chose not to remove; the chair will say no joint meeting is set for Monday and a written opinion from Town Council goes to the Planning Board.
The town manager announced that free cash was certified by the state, with a recommendation for its use to come in the FY21 budget process.
The only vote was adjournment; the next old primary school workshop is to be tried for the first week of December.

why_it_matters: The future of the old primary school building could bring a demolition, a sale or transfer, or a renovation, and each path carries different costs to the town budget, mostly taxes.
Free cash, once certified, is the pool the board will recommend uses for in the FY21 budget, which residents may be asked to vote on at Town Meeting.
watch_next: Next old primary school workshop, to be tried for the first week of December.
The free cash use recommendation, which is to be part of the FY21 budget process.
